thread:
Sam (sales-eng): POC kickoff prep for AtlasBank tomorrow. They want SSO-only invites, SCIM sync, and an ephemeral CI service account. Also asking if billing visibility can be separated.
Alex (infra): Yep. We can disable static keys at workspace level and require ephemeral tokens. SCIM group mapping -> roles supported.
Priya (security): We'll send a short least-privilege matrix: svc-inference, billing-view, viewer; only POC owner gets workspace-admin. Recommend IP allowlist for minting and KMS if they plan to use sensitive data.
Mateo (acct exec): For Dedicated trial: offer 1-week small reserved pool with prorated commit if they need sustained concurrency. Else hosted + burst credits ok.
Sam (sales-eng): Can you drop a minimal invite payload I can paste to their IdP team?
Alex (infra): Minimal invite (SCIM-friendly):
```json
{
  "email": "poc-bot@atlasbank.com",
  "display_name": "Atlas POC Bot",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "atlas-poc",
  "expires_at": "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Priya (security): Add `billing-view` for their finance contact. I'll draft the questionnaire reply and SAML claim mapping.
Sam (sales-eng): Thanks — action items assigned. I'll share the invite and schedule the kickoff. :thumbsup:
